lines.zh: 雪地里每一步都咯吱作响。
lines.en: Every step crunches through the snow.

lines.zh: 冰刺划破我的袍角，无所谓。
lines.en: Ice spikes tear my rags. I do not care.
The wind fills in my footprints.

lines.zh: 这片雪原，走上千年也不腻。
lines.en: A thousand years on this snowfield would not bore me.
My bones are colder than the snow.

lines.zh: 别踩碎那层薄冰，底下是水。
lines.en: Do not break that thin ice. Water waits below.
The frozen earth is hard. Good footing.

lines.zh: 我跟着雪一起挪动，很慢。
lines.en: I drift along with the snow, slowly.

lines.zh: 雪落在肩上，我就不抖了。
lines.en: Snow settles on my shoulders and I stop shivering.
Past the ice fields, more ice fields.

lines.zh: 步子放轻，猎物才听不见。
lines.en: Soft steps, so the prey never hears.
Only white is left where I have walked.

lines.zh: 关节冻住了，得等一会儿。
lines.en: My joints have frozen. Give them a moment.
No birdsong on a snowfield morning.

lines.zh: 我听见冰层在慢慢裂开。
lines.en: I hear the ice sheet splitting, slowly.
The wind comes down from the peaks.
Frost on bone. It suits me.

lines.zh: 谁把火把插在那儿？太亮了。
lines.en: Who planted that torch? Far too bright.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只是习惯。
lines.en: I do not need to breathe. Old habit.
This river has frozen solid.
When the snow stops, I will move.
Another flake falls into my eye socket.
Your breath fogs the air. How fresh.
You are still alive. Your legs are still warm.
Do not walk so fast. You will sweat.
You are dressed far too lightly. Cold?

lines.zh: 我在你靴子上看见了雪。
lines.en: I see snow on your boots.
You carry the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 站住，让我记住你的骨头。
lines.en: Stand still. Let me remember your bones.

lines.zh: 你会喜欢这里的安静的。
lines.en: You will come to like the quiet here.

lines.zh: 眼睛别乱瞟，我一直看着。
lines.en: Keep your eyes still. I am watching.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖开始发僵了吧。
lines.en: Your knees are stiffening already, are they not?
That knocked some frost off.
A bone broke. I will put it back.

lines.zh: 你打得很响，可惜没感觉。
lines.en: You hit loudly. Pity I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 退开，我不喜欢热的东西。
lines.en: Back away. I dislike warm things near me.
Shatter me. The snow will assemble me again.
Your hands are shaking. The cold, I think.

lines.zh: 我退一步，只是让雪落稳。
lines.en: I step back only to let the snow settle.
Hm. A joint slipped.
I have broken before. It is nothing.
Not the face. The face is just a bone.

lines.zh: 食物？我早就不吃东西了。
lines.en: Food? I stopped eating long ago.
Put the bread away. I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，不如一支箭。
lines.en: What you hold is worth less than one arrow.

lines.zh: 金子？我连骨头都数不清。
lines.en: Gold? I cannot even count my bones.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我忘了味道。
lines.en: Do not wave that meat. I forgot its taste.

lines.zh: 我不是狗，不会跟着你走。
lines.en: I am no dog. I will not follow you.
You want to feed me? Bring your hand closer.

lines.zh: 我只对拉弓这件事有兴趣。
lines.en: Only drawing a bow interests me.

lines.zh: 你的好意，冻不化我的骨头。
lines.en: Your kindness will not thaw my bones.
Take it away. I only want your slowness.
Why shove me? I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是骨头，不是肉。
lines.en: You bumped into bone, not flesh.
Back off. My quiver is on my back.
You are warmer than me. That is unfair.

lines.zh: 再挤，我就把霜蹭你身上。
lines.en: Push again and I will rub frost on you.
Do not touch my bow. It might loose.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，你偏要贴过来。
lines.en: The road is wide. You still press against me.

lines.zh: 雪被我们踩得乱七八糟。
lines.en: We have trampled the snow into a mess.
Your shoulder is burning hot.

lines.zh: 让开，我要去那边的冰坡。
lines.en: Move. I am bound for that ice slope.
A companion? Only I walk this snowfield.

lines.zh: 骷髅没有心事，也没有伴。
lines.en: Skeletons keep no secrets and no partners.

lines.zh: 你要给我找个伴？她也会冷。
lines.en: Find me a mate? She would be cold too.
I do not breed. I stand.

lines.zh: 雪堆里那副旧骨架是谁的？
lines.en: Whose old skeleton lies in that drift?

lines.zh: 两副骨头碰在一起，太吵。
lines.en: Two skeletons clacking together is too loud.

lines.zh: 我一个人守这片冰就够了。
lines.en: One of me is enough to keep this ice.
Do not pair me off. I know the way.

lines.zh: 等雪把我埋了，就没人问了。
lines.en: When the snow buries me, no one will ask.
This bow is my companion.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我留着当备件。
lines.en: This bone is a spare part. I will keep it.
Arrows I collect. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 谁丢的皮革？我不穿衣服。
lines.en: Dropped leather? I wear no clothes.
What the ice seals away is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起一支断箭，还能用。
lines.en: I pick up a broken arrow. Still usable.

lines.zh: 这堆雪里埋了什么东西？
lines.en: What is buried in this snowdrift?

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，我拿来扔着玩。
lines.en: You dropped seeds. I will toss them about.
Picking it up will not warm my hands.
I am not greedy. Only arrows and bones.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，都是雪先挑的。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the ground, the snow chose first.
Something living, steaming in the snow.
I can see your breath.
Halt. My bow is already drawn.
Another warm one, come to donate.
Your boot prints sink far too deep.
The wind has dropped. Perfect for aiming.
Do not run. The snow will trip you.

lines.zh: 猎物总以为冰原很安全。
lines.en: Prey always thinks the ice fields are safe.
I see a patch of red moving.
You have stepped into my snowfield.
Since you came, slow down.
Close enough. No need to chase.
That shape behind the ice spikes, is it you?
My bones are rattling. That is me laughing.
There is a new patch of warmth on the ice.
Two more steps and my arrow arrives.
The more you run, the heavier your legs.
Frost will crawl in along the arrowhead.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你会自己慢下来。
lines.en: I need not chase. You will slow on your own.

lines.zh: 我瞄准没有护甲的地方。
lines.en: I aim where no armor covers you.
The snow glare hides me from you.

lines.zh: 呼吸别乱，我在数你的步子。
lines.en: Steady your breath. I am counting your steps.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your knees are shaking. I see it.
The arrow is nocked. The string groans.
Do not hide behind that tree. I can hear you.
Cold is a very patient thing.

lines.zh: 一只脚抬起，另一只就慢了。
lines.en: One foot lifts, and the other grows slow.

lines.zh: 我走过这片雪，不留声音。
lines.en: I cross this snow without a sound.
At last you stop to catch your breath.
I draw the bow, and frost gathers on the string.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了薄冰，声音传得远。
lines.en: You break thin ice, and the sound carries far.
I raise the arrow a little and wait for the wind.
You can count my arrows and still lose track.
This arrow is my greeting.

lines.zh: 退后也没用，箭头在你肩上。
lines.en: Backing away will not help. The arrow is in your shoulder.
Come closer and I will club you with the bow.
Your blood looks black on the snow.
Do not pull it out. It will slow you further.
Bone has a decent grip.
This one freezes your ankle.

lines.zh: 射偏了？不，是留给下一箭。
lines.en: Missed? No. I saved that for the next shot.
You step back once, I step forward twice.
The quiver is still full.
Do not raise that shield. It will split.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，这就是破绽。
lines.en: Your breathing broke. That is the opening.
Go home, while your legs still move.
Lying in the snow is warmer than standing.

lines.zh: 我用箭杆敲你的腕，弓掉了。
lines.en: I strike your wrist with the shaft, and the bow drops.

lines.zh: 骨节撞上你的护肩，很硬。
lines.en: My knuckles hit your pauldron. Hard.

lines.zh: 雪原上又多了一副骨架。
lines.en: One more skeleton on the snowfield.
I climb out from beneath the ice.
The wind has put me together.

lines.zh: 这里本该站着另一具骷髅。
lines.en: Another skeleton should be standing here.

lines.zh: 雪落在我身上，像盖被子。
lines.en: Snow settles on me like a blanket.
Cold? I was born this way.
The ice spikes make a fine home.
I hear the ice welcoming me.

lines.zh: 这块露天的位置，我占了。
lines.en: This open spot is taken by me.
First rattle of my joints. How crisp.

lines.zh: 从冻河站起来，水都结冰了。
lines.en: I rose from the frozen river. The water froze over.
Stay back. I have only just learned to draw.
This stretch of snow is mine to walk now.
Another long stretch of white.
Fire? I dislike warm things.

lines.zh: 从崖上滚下来，骨头倒没事。
lines.en: Rolled off a cliff. The bones are fine.
Underwater is too quiet. I am not used to it.
Nothing but echoes in my head.

lines.zh: 用我的方法打我，有点意思。
lines.en: Using my own method on me. Amusing.

lines.zh: 这股暖意，让我很不舒服。
lines.en: This warmth makes me deeply uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，这算什么伤。
lines.en: I do not eat. What kind of wound is this?

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，像在点灯。
lines.en: Lightning struck me like lighting a lamp.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有雪，也没有回声。
lines.en: No snow in the void, and no echo.
